# VerificationGlue

> Assertions for .NET tests in any framework. Write a C# condition with `Verify`, and the source generator writes the failure message: the condition, a message for its shape, the file and line, and with tier 3 the value of each part. Works under Native AOT.

## Rules

- Import the methods with `using static VerificationGlue.VerifySyntax;`. Add `using VerificationGlue;` for `[Verify]`, `VerifyScope` and `VerifyException`.
- Write every check as a lambda that returns one `bool` condition: `Verify(() => order.Total == 40)`, `Verify(() => items.Contains(3))`, `Check(() => order.Total == 40)`. A failure lists the value of each part, in any method, including an xunit, NUnit, MSTest or TUnit test body. The body runs once. It must be a single expression. Do not write a message for what the condition already says.
- Write `Verify(condition)` without a lambda only in three cases: the condition uses `await`, which a `Func<bool>` cannot contain; it reads a `Span<T>` or another `ref struct`, which a lambda cannot capture; or the next lines rely on a null check in it, such as `Verify(name is not null);` followed by `name.Length`. Only `Verify(condition)` tells the compiler that a value is not null afterwards. `NotNull(value)` does too, and returns the value.
- Analyzer VG0009 suggests the lambda form for any other `Verify(condition)` or `Check(condition)` in a test method. Set `<VerificationGlueLambdaSeverity>warning</VerificationGlueLambdaSeverity>` to make it a build warning, or `none` to turn it off.
- Add context with an interpolated message: `Verify(order.Total == 40, $"order {order.Id}")`. Its holes run only on failure. No lambda form takes a message.
- Use `Throws<T>(() => ...)` and `await ThrowsAsync<T>(() => ...)` for exceptions. Both return the exception, and both accept a type derived from `T`. Use `ThrowsExactly<T>` and `ThrowsExactlyAsync<T>` when only exactly `T` should pass.
- Use `Single(items)`, `Single(items, predicate)`, `Is<T>(value)` and `NotNull(value)` to check a value and use it in one step: `var node = Single(doc.Nodes, n => n.Id == "A");`. Each returns what it checked. Do not write `Verify(items.Count == 1)` followed by `items[0]`, or `Verify(x is T)` followed by a cast.
- `Throws`, `Single`, `Is` and `NotNull` throw on failure also inside a `VerifyScope`, because a failure has no value to return.
- Use `Check(() => condition)` to record a failure and continue. Open a scope with `using (VerifyScope.Begin()) { ... }` in xunit, NUnit, MSTest and TUnit. The scope throws one `VerifyException` listing every failure when it ends. With no scope, `Check` throws at once.
- Do not change state inside a condition. `Verify(i++ == 0)` is reported by VG0003.
- Do not compare `double` or `float` with `==`. Compare the difference with a tolerance. VG0004 reports it.
- Tier 3 also gives values for `Verify(condition)`: set `<VerificationGlueRewrite>true</VerificationGlueRewrite>` in the project, put the checks in a method marked `[Verify]` in a `partial` type, and call that method directly. An xunit or NUnit test method itself runs through reflection and gets no tier 3 values.
- `.Because("...")` after `Verify(...)` works only in a method that tier 3 rewrites. Anywhere else it is build error VG0001. Use the interpolated message there.
- Each diagnostic ID links to a page under `docs/diagnostics/` with the fix.

## Docs

- [Getting started](https://github.com/ipjohnson/VerificationGlue/blob/main/docs/guide/getting-started-verify.md): install and the first check in each test framework.
- [How tiers work and how to get values](https://github.com/ipjohnson/VerificationGlue/blob/main/docs/guide/tiers.md)
- [Soft checks with Check](https://github.com/ipjohnson/VerificationGlue/blob/main/docs/guide/check.md)
- [Failure messages](https://github.com/ipjohnson/VerificationGlue/blob/main/docs/guide/messages.md): the real output of each kind of failure.
- [Migrate from xunit Assert](https://github.com/ipjohnson/VerificationGlue/blob/main/docs/guide/migrate-from-xunit-assert.md): the `Verify` form of each `Assert` call.
- [Generated interceptors](https://github.com/ipjohnson/VerificationGlue/blob/main/docs/guide/generated/interceptors.md) and [generated tier 3 copies](https://github.com/ipjohnson/VerificationGlue/blob/main/docs/guide/generated/rewritten-methods.md)
